question: Which of the following screwdrivers has cross-shaped tips that are unlikely to slip from the cruciform slots in Philips recessed head screws?
solution:
The correct answer is __Cross-recess screwdriver****.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cross-recess screwdriver__ is specifically designed with cross-shaped tips.
 
• These tips are less likely to slip from the cruciform slots in Phillips recessed head screws.
 
• This type of screwdriver is commonly used in various assembling and repair tasks.
 
• It provides better grip and torque compared to other types of screwdrivers.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Offset screwdriver:**
 
 
• An offset screwdriver is used to access screws in tight spaces.
 
• It has a bent design to provide a better angle.
 
 
 
• **Stumpy screwdriver: **
 
 
• Stumpy screwdrivers are short screwdrivers designed for working in confined areas.
 
• They are not ideal for screws requiring high torque.
 
 
 
• **Ratchet screwdriver:**
 
 
• A ratchet screwdriver allows the user to turn the screw in one direction without repositioning the tool.
 
• It is suitable for repetitive screwing tasks.
